SELECT c.CHECK_ID, c.REQUESTER_ID, c.TARGET_MEMBER_ID, c.INCIDENT_ID, c.STATUS, c.REQUESTED_AT, c.CONFIRMED_AT, m.NAME AS TARGET_MEMBER_NAME, i.TITLE AS INCIDENT_TITLE FROM SF_SAFETY_CHECK c JOIN SF_MEMBER m ON c.TARGET_MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN SF_INCIDENT i ON c.INCIDENT_ID = i.INCIDENT_ID WHERE c.REQUESTER_ID = #{requesterId} ORDER BY c.REQUESTED_AT DESC
